scope: readout-channel diagnostic, not a hypothesis test of pi0.5 semantics
primary: layer 3, robot_instruction source context, base camera visual tokens

criteria.native_reader: report direct real-image candidate and generation accuracy
criteria.candidate_consistency: report both control images separately, complete red/blue pair accuracy, and opposite-color donor following
criteria.free_generation: report separately with exact short-label parser; no substitution by candidate ranking

limitations: two scene groups/four images, old calibration data
CPU float32 differs from previous GPU bfloat16
no claim that same-model success establishes cross-model alignment
threshold_policy: no best-layer selection or statistical-significance claim; show all predeclared conditions
